description: This file defines the PartitionStrategy trait and several implementations for partitioning edges in a graph, including strategies like 2D, 1D, random, and canonical random vertex cuts, used within Apache Spark's GraphX component.

classes.name: PartitionStrategy
classes.description: A trait representing different strategies for assigning edges to partitions based on source and destination vertex IDs.

classes.name: PartitionStrategy.EdgePartition2D
classes.description: Implements a 2D edge partitioning strategy to balance load and minimize vertex replication.

classes.name: PartitionStrategy.EdgePartition1D
classes.description: Partitions edges based solely on the source vertex ID, colocating edges with the same source.

classes.name: PartitionStrategy.RandomVertexCut
classes.description: Partitions edges by hashing source and destination IDs, resulting in a random vertex cut.

classes.name: PartitionStrategy.CanonicalRandomVertexCut
classes.description: Partitions edges by hashing source and destination IDs in a canonical order, regardless of direction.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition number for a given edge based on the specific partitioning strategy.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a PartitionStrategy instance from a string name.
